parts.key_points_summary: Introduction to basic economic concepts, including scarcity, opportunity cost, micro and macroeconomics.
learning_objectives: Define economics and its core principles.
Understand the concepts of scarcity, opportunity cost, and trade-offs.
parts.title: Foundations of Economics

parts.key_points_summary: Detailed study of supply, demand, and market equilibrium. Elasticity concepts are also included.
learning_objectives: Explain the laws of supply and demand.
Analyze factors that shift supply and demand curves.
Determine equilibrium price and quantity in a market.
parts.title: Supply and Demand

parts.key_points_summary: Exploration of various market structures and their impact on firms' behavior and market outcomes.
learning_objectives: Identify different market structures (perfect competition, monopoly, oligopoly, monopolistic competition).
Analyze the characteristics and behavior of firms in each market structure.
Evaluate the efficiency and welfare implications of different market structures.
parts.title: Market Structures

parts.key_points_summary: An overview of macroeconomic indicators and their significance in understanding the economy.
learning_objectives: Define and measure key macroeconomic indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment).
Understand the relationship between these indicators.
Analyze the causes and consequences of macroeconomic fluctuations.
parts.title: Macroeconomic Indicators

parts.key_points_summary: Explanation of monetary and fiscal policies and their effects on economic stability.
learning_objectives: Explain the role of monetary policy in stabilizing the economy.
Analyze the tools and effectiveness of fiscal policy.
Evaluate the challenges of macroeconomic policymaking.
parts.title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy
